# tebib_public_ip (Resource)

A public IPv4 address allocated to the project. Point it at a VM or NAT gateway with `tebib_public_ip_association`. Deleting it releases the address: you may not get the same one again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_public_ip" "web" {
  name = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's public IPs. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The IPv4 address.
- `association` (String) What the address points at: `none`, `vm` or `nat-gateway`.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Public IP ID (`eip-...`).
- `nat_gateway_id` (String) The NAT gateway that carries its traffic, if any (also set for a VM's address).
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.
- `vm_id` (String) The VM it points at, if any.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tebib_public_ip.web eip-abc123
```
